response.overview: The end of an era. Oliver Murphy takes an introspective look back at his teenage years in this psychological comedic neo-noir character study, as he is forced to face his issues head-on and his life is thrown into turmoil while uncertainty looms in this extended edition , that include's all completed but cut scenes from the original.
